2.69.32
Table.TableGroups
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Table.TableGroups element specifies the collection of table groups consisting of group
expressions, group headers, and group footers for a table. This element is optional and is of type
TableGroups.
Following is the parent element of the Table.TableGroups element.
Parent elements
Table
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Table.TableGroups element.
 <xsd:element name="TableGroups" type="TableGroupsType" minOccurs="0" />
